naturally_trimmed.config.enable_features: Enables the Loot Table trimming feature
Enables the Villager Trade Trimming feature
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.toolti: Settings for trimming a mobs equipment
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.trimSy:
Select the trim system. Trim systems define how the mod chooses what trims to use.

- Random Trims: Randomly chooses the trim to apply to the mob.

- Predefined Trims: Chooses the trim from a list of predefined trims. You can manage the list of trims under the predefined_trims config entry (only inside the config file)
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.noTrim: Chance of the mob having no trims at all
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.trimCh: Chance of each individual armor piece having a trim
Settings for trimming items generated by loot tables
Chance of an item generated by a loot table of having a trim applied
naturally_trimmed.config.trimTrades.trim: Chance of a trade of having a trim applied
naturally_trimmed.config.trimTrades.minL: The minimum villager trading level a item needs to be in, to have a chance of being trimmed
naturally_trimmed.config.textureValidati:
Enables filtering trims by checking for the corresponding textures of the trim.
This is the best filtering method, since it directly checks for the textures.
For more info about missing-texture trims, see the mods description.

However, this only works on the client, it will be not be applied on dedicated servers, due to textures not being available on serverside.
When this setting *is* applied (on client + enabled), it will override all other filtering,
including the vanillaOnly setting, the blacklists and the built-in trim filtering, as these will become unnecessary
naturally_trimmed.config.vanillaOnly.des:
Use and filter for vanilla-only trim materials and patterns.

The intended use for this is to easily filter no-texture trims, when the texture_validation_filtering isn't available.
For more info about missing-texture trims, see the mods description.
For more advanced workarounds, without having to blacklist all non-vanilla trims, see material_blacklist and pattern_blacklist
Filter trim materials.

See https://github.com/Imajo24I/Naturally-Trimmed/wiki/Config#trim-material-filter--material_filter for documentation on this.

Example configuration, blacklisting everything but biomes_o_plenty's trim materials and all trim materials that have the c:gold tag:
material_filter: ["+biomes_o_plenty:.*", "+#c:gold", "-.*"],
naturally_trimmed.config.patternFilter.d:
Filter trim patterns.

See https://github.com/Imajo24I/Naturally-Trimmed/wiki/Config#trim-pattern-filter--pattern_filter for documentation on this.

Example configuration, blacklisting everything but the silence trim pattern
pattern_filter: ["+minecraft:silence", "-.*"],
